entries.question: Confirm scope: select and integrate downloaded SFX for character speech, coin insertion, claw movement and grip/release, chute drop, ball rolling, rack arrival and overflow ejection, plus Coinie footsteps/jump/smoke and UI clicks; synchronise cues with animations, support mute and reduced motion, update attribution records, and exclude music. Capsule reveal/discard sounds apply only if those interactions exist at implementation time.
